# Populations

## Population density

```{r dense, echo=T, eval=T}
library(spatstat)
bei
plot(bei)
```

## Maps of density

```{r densemap, echo=T, eval=T}
dmap <- density(bei)
plot(dmap)
```

## Population dispersion

```{r disperse, echo=F, eval=T}

library(terra)
library(sdm)
library(viridis)
file <- system.file("external/species.shp", package="sdm")
rana <- vect(file)
pres <- rana[rana$Occurrence==1]

# Covariates
elev <- system.file("external/elevation.asc", package="sdm")
# [1] "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/sdm/external/elevation.asc"

elevmap <- rast(elev)

# Exercise: import temperature and plot presences vs. temperature
temp <- system.file("external/temperature.asc", package="sdm")

tempmap <- rast(temp)

# precipitation
prec <- system.file("external/precipitation.asc", package="sdm")

precmap <- rast(prec)

# vegetation
vege <- system.file("external/vegetation.asc", package="sdm")
vegemap <- rast(vege)

par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(elevmap)
points(pres)
plot(tempmap)
points(pres)
plot(precmap)
points(pres)
plot(vegemap)
points(pres)
```

## Multivariate analysis

```{r multivar, echo=T, eval=T}

library(vegan)
data(dune)
multivar <- decorana(dune)
plot(multivar)
```

## Community overlap

```{r overlap, echo=F, eval=T}
library(overlap)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
data(kerinci)
circulartime <- kerinci$Time * 2 * pi
kerinci$Timecirc <- kerinci$Time * 2 * pi
tiger <- kerinci[kerinci$Sps=="tiger",]
tigertime <- tiger$Timecirc
densityPlot(tigertime)
macaque <- kerinci[kerinci$Sps=="macaque",]
macaquetime <- macaque$Timecirc
densityPlot(macaquetime)
overlapPlot(tigertime, macaquetime)
```

## Graph theory

```{r grapht, echo=T, eval=T}
library(igraph)

species <- c("Algae", "Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Large Fish", "Bird")

predator <- c("Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Large Fish", "Bird", "Bird")
prey <- c("Algae", "Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Small Fish", "Large Fish")

interactions <- data.frame(predator, prey)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(interactions, vertices = species, directed = T)
plot(g)
```

## Graph theory

```{r grapht2, echo=F, eval=T}
library(igraph)

species <- c("Algae", "Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Large Fish", "Bird")

predator <- c("Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Large Fish", "Bird", "Bird")
prey <- c("Algae", "Zooplankton", "Small Fish", "Small Fish", "Large Fish")

interactions <- data.frame(predator, prey)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(interactions, vertices = species, directed = T)
plot(g)
```

## Remote sensing

```{r rs, echo=T, eval=T}

library(imageRy)
library(terra)

# importing the first band
snt <- im.import("sentinel.d")
im.plotRGB(snt, 4,3,2)
```

## Remote sensing

```{r rs2, echo=T, eval=T}
im.plotRGB(snt, 4,3,2)
```

## Spectral indices

```{r si, echo=F, eval=T}

library(imageRy)
library(terra)

# importing the first band
snt <- im.import("Sentinel2_NDVI")
plot(snt)
```

## Classification

```{r class, echo=T, eval=T}
sun <- im.import("Solar_Orbiter_s_first_views_of_the_Sun_pillars.jpg")
```

## Classification

```{r class2, echo=T, eval=T}
sunc <- im.classify(sun, num_clusters=3) 
```

## Time series analysis

```{r ts, echo=T, eval=T}
ndvi <- im.import("NDVI_2020")
```

## Time series analysis

```{r ts2, echo=T, eval=T}
names(ndvi)=c("02-feb","05-may","08-aug","11-nov")
im.ridgeline(ndvi, scale=2)
```

## Spatial variablity

```{r sv, echo=T, eval=T}
sent <- im.import("sentinel.png")
```

## Spatial variablity

```{r sv2, echo=T, eval=T}
sd5 <- terra::focal(sent[[1]], w=5, fun="sd")
plot(sd5)
```
